description: Bulk domain availability: for up to 20 domains, asks the authoritative registry over RDAP (server chosen from the IANA RDAP bootstrap). RDAP 404 = available; registered names return registrar, IANA id, creation/expiry dates, status and nameservers. TLDs without RDAP fall back to a DNS NS check; subdomains are flagged. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/domain-availability
name: domain_availability
title: Domain Availability
